mr_title: refactor(@angular-devkit/build-angular): use Node.js promise fs API in service-worker augmentation
mr_description:
With the minimum version of Node.js now set to v12, the promise fs API can now be leveraged within the tooling.
This change also uses `copyFile` (with copy-on-write where available) to setup the the service worker files as well a streaming APIs to generate service worker hashes. Both of which improves performance and reduces memory usage.

expected_issues.title: Nested Windows assets get invalid service-worker paths
expected_issues.description:
The asset walker applies path.posix.relative/join to native Windows paths. Root-level files can still yield valid relative names, but nested directories containing backslashes are treated as a single POSIX component.

For a base such as C:\project\dist and a nested dir C:\project\dist\assets, relative() can produce a ../C:\... path instead of assets/file. Asset-group patterns then omit nested files from ngsw.json. Compute paths with native filesystem semantics and normalize the resulting relative names to forward slashes.
